answer_1.quote: To produce definitions for these words, we generated text from GPT-3, primed with input in the format "word (POS.) -". Usually, GPT-3's outputs had the style of a dictionary definition

answer_2.quote: For each word w and definition d in the lexicon (where d may be the definition of a word different from w), we compute the likelihood under GPT-3 of the definition d to follow word w, p(d|w).

answer_3.quote: If GPT-3 were to perform the matching task done by our human subjects, it would choose the option with higher total likelihood.

answer_4.quote: The studies with human subjects were performed on Amazon Mechanical Turk, with workers from the pool of native English speakers with at least 95% approval rating.
answer_4.guideline: Users were asked to decide which assignment of definitions to words is a better fit and to rate their confidence
